2021-02-21.narrative: Rates scare: 10-year yields jumped and risk assets sold off (22-23 Feb) after Musk called prices 'high'

2021-04-13.narrative: Top around the Coinbase listing (14 Apr); Turkey banned crypto payments (16 Apr); the 18 Apr weekend flash crash on a Xinjiang power-outage rumour

2021-05-08.narrative: Tesla stopped Bitcoin payments (12 May), China banned institutional crypto services (18 May) and announced a mining crackdown (21 May); leverage unwound over four weeks

2021-06-14.narrative: Hawkish June FOMC dot plot (16 Jun) and the Sichuan mining shutdown (19-20 Jun) that halved hash rate; grind to the 20 Jul low

2021-09-06.narrative: El Salvador launch flash crash (7 Sep) then the Evergrande risk-off (20 Sep); China declared all crypto transactions illegal on 24 Sep

2021-11-08.narrative: Fed pivot: Powell retired 'transitory' (30 Nov), the FOMC doubled the taper (15 Dec) and the minutes flagged balance-sheet runoff (5 Jan); Omicron (26 Nov); Kazakhstan internet shutdown hit hash rate (5-6 Jan); Russia's central bank proposed a ban (20 Jan)

2022-03-29.narrative: The tightening cycle bit: 50 bp (4 May) and 75 bp (15 Jun) hikes with CPI at 8.3-8.6% and a 20% S&P 500 drawdown; inside it Terra/UST collapsed (9-13 May), Celsius froze withdrawals (12 Jun) and Three Arrows Capital failed (mid-Jun), forcing sales

2022-08-13.narrative: Strong dollar and Jackson Hole 'pain' speech (26 Aug); the 19 Aug liquidation cascade; equities gave back the summer rally

2022-11-05.narrative: FTX collapse (8-11 Nov) and contagion (Genesis halted withdrawals 16 Nov)

2023-07-13.narrative: Fade after the Ripple ruling; SpaceX write-down report and Evergrande filing (17 Aug); 10-year real yields at 16-year highs; SEC delayed spot-ETF decisions (31 Aug)

2024-05-20.narrative: Hawkish June FOMC dots (12 Jun), Mt. Gox repayment announcement (24 Jun) and German government wallet sales (Jun-Jul); spot-ETF outflows

2024-07-28.narrative: Weak July payrolls (2 Aug) then the yen carry-trade unwind (5 Aug)

2024-12-17.narrative: Hawkish December FOMC (18 Dec); then tariff escalation from February to 'Liberation Day' (2 Apr), the $1.5bn Bybit hack (21 Feb), record ETF outflows (25 Feb) and a strategic-reserve order without purchases (7 Mar); S&P 500 down 17%

2025-10-06.narrative: The 10 Oct tariff shock and record $19bn liquidation; ETF outflows and the break below $100k (4 Nov); Greenland tariff scare (20 Jan); Fed pause (28-29 Jan); cross-asset deleveraging with the software and precious-metals rout (5 Feb) — archive headlines

2026-05-10.narrative: U.S. strikes on Iran and oil, rate-hike bets and $480m/$500m ETF outflows on 1-3 Jun; break below $70k; trough 30 Jun — archive headlines
